description: Java class defining X.509 client certificate credentials with JSON serialization/deserialization, builder pattern, and credential interface implementation.

classes.name: ClientCertificateCredentials
classes.description: Immutable class representing client certificate credentials with optional certificate and key, supporting JSON serialization, equality, and builder pattern.

classes.name: ClientCertificateCredentials.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of ClientCertificateCredentials.

classes.name: ClientCertificateCredentials.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON field names for serialization/deserialization of credentials.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a CredentialsVisitor and invokes its clientCertificate method.

methods.name: getClientCertificate
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the client certificate if present.

methods.name: getClientKey
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the client key if present.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on clientCertificate and clientKey.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on clientCertificate and clientKey.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the credentials to a JsonObject.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a ClientCertificateCredentials instance.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an instance with no certificates.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with current object's fields.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Setter for client certificate in builder.

methods.name: clientKey
methods.description: Setter for client key in builder.
